caption: Worked example with HZ = 250: the first blocks give 250 jiffies in 1 s and 5 jiffies in 20 ms. The last blocks divide the 32-bit count of 4,294,967,296 ticks by 250, then by 86,400, so the counter wraps after about 198.84 days.

spec.title: Worked example: HZ = 250
spec.aria: A vertical chain of blocks: HZ = 250 gives 1 s = 250 jiffies and 20 ms = 5 jiffies, then the 32-bit count 4,294,967,296 ticks divided by 250 gives 17,179,869.184 s, and divided by 86,400 gives about 198.84 days.
